title: The Open Compass
author: Mara Galloway
blurb: Yara Pemberton, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, keeps moving because stopping costs more. Then the tide reveals a cave that legends charge admission to — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must bring the expedition home without telling anyone what it found, and time is already running out.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
